dialogues.speaker: Iron Tongue Tian
dialogues.text: Have you heard? This year's Lantern Rite has a new event: a musical performance!

dialogues.speaker: Iron Tongue Tian
dialogues.text: If you want to fit in, you should talk about music.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Tongue Tian
dialogues.text: But it's hard to attract an audience when you have a romantic atmosphere without a powerful scene...

dialogues.speaker: Iron Tongue Tian
dialogues.text: Do you think it's possible to combine singing and fighting?

dialogues.speaker: Iron Tongue Tian
dialogues.text: Winning a battle while being accompanied by a dynamic rhythm... Yeah, I think that's a good idea.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Tongue Tian
dialogues.text: You wouldn't be able to hear of this story from my fellow, Tea Master Liu Su. All he does is talk about dry, prissy, genteel stuff!
